attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/legacy2/numeric-record-ordering/bin/merge. It now performs CSV-aware numeric ordering, emits one header, deduplicates identical records, rejects conflicting IDs with a clear explanation, and publishes atomically so failures preserve merged.csv. The repair and data survived node1’s mandatory restart. Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic remain installed.
